tmdb.title: TMDB enrichment
tmdb.missing: No API key: scanning will work, without automatic pre-filling of movie details.
tmdb.hint: Free personal key: themoviedb.org → Settings → API. Stored only on this drive (data\), never shared. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
tmdb.resultValid: Valid key — movie enrichment is operational.
tmdb.resultInvalid: Key rejected by TMDB: check your input.
tmdb.resultOffline: Offline: cannot verify right now. The key is saved and can be tested when online.

home.forcedScanNotice: No movie recognized: scanning is required.
home.toQualifyNotice: {{count}} file(s) to qualify — run a scan.
home.missingNotice: {{count}} indexed file(s) not found on the drive.

browse.title: My library
browse.empty: Nothing to show. Run a scan to qualify your files.

scan.title: Scan the files
scan.rootsHint: Paths relative to the root of the drive the app lives on, without a drive letter (e.g. “Movies” for X:\Movies; in dev, “Users/me/Videos” for C:\Users\me\Videos).
scan.rootInvalid: No drive letter (C:, E:…): enter a path relative to the root of the drive the app lives on — e.g. “Movies” or “Users/me/Videos”.
scan.importedHint: These files arrived with their .nfo sidecar: they were added to the library without questions, offline.
scan.missingHint: Deleting a movie entry is permanent and asks for confirmation. A file that comes back will reappear automatically on the next scan.
scan.confirmDeleteMessage: “{{title}}” and all its information (cast, genres, tags, watch state) will be removed from the index. The video file itself is never touched.
scan.seriesHint: Series are not handled yet (planned after v1): these files are set aside.
scan.noTech: Technical analysis failed (corrupted file or missing ffprobe).
scan.chipsHint: Press Enter or comma to add an item to the lists.
scan.noNewFiles: Nothing new: the library matches the drive.
scan.done: All new files have been processed.
